method.tutorials: All 125 PDFs were fetched as raw bytes outside Git; SHA-256, byte size, PDF header, and page count were recorded; all 504 pages were rendered and readable text layers compared as an aid. Matched question-page sets were compared visually in contact sheets and selected pages at full resolution. OCR/text extraction was not treated as proof of mathematical correctness.
method.reviews: For the 50 previously classified MH1100/MH2100 review and exam IDs: authenticated read-only raw fetch; SHA-256, byte size, page count and text-layer pages; hash comparison for exact duplicates; rendered comparison for the MH1100 Final Review pair and MH2100 Lecture 12 image-based review. The 87 public MH1100/MH1101 Final/Midterm records were fetched, hashed, page-counted and text-layer profiled outside Git. One private learning record was excluded from public row-level metadata and content classification. All same-year MH1100 question aliases (10 final pairs and 3 midterm pairs) were rendered and compared page by page; unmatched solution content was classified by role, and image-only answer pages remain unresolved. The 51 public MH1101 records have unique whole-PDF hashes; all 165 sparse/empty-text pages in 28 public files were rendered. Four same-year alternate Midterm pairs had question pages rendered in this review; prompt pages matched, and handwritten-work additions are located by page. Four page-text-signature collision groups were visually confirmed to be different.
method.privacy: No source PDF, rendered page, OCR transcript, extracted problem text, answer text, or handwritten work is included. Public rows contain nonprivate source IDs, titles, file metadata, whole-file hashes, text-signature hashes and page locators only. One private learning record is excluded from row-level public metadata and content classification; only an aggregate count is retained.

classificationKey.duplicate: Same prompt/content established by full-file hash or rendered page comparison. A content duplicate may differ at the binary/page-geometry level.
classificationKey.elaboration: Solution, concept, or explanation companion; no mathematical correctness claim.
classificationKey.distinct_task: Distinct assessment or instructional artifact within the reviewed archive; this does not imply a new public course outcome.
classificationKey.unresolved: Image-only, handwritten, unreadable, or mathematical-variant status could not be established.
